_readme: Hand-written categories for Set 18 (Enchanted Wilds). Members were checked against the ability text in set.json. 'ambiguous' champions arguably fit, so the generator keeps them off the board whenever that category is used. 'abilityPattern' fills in breakdown notes and lets `npm run categories:report` flag champions you may have missed. Auto categories (costs, traits, name patterns...) are built in scripts/lib/categories.ts; drop one with 'disabled' or tweak it with 'overrides'.

categories.title: Abilities That Stun
categories.description: Each of these champions' abilities Stuns enemies.

categories.title: Abilities That Grant a Shield
categories.description: Their abilities create a Shield. Shields from traits like Vanguard and Solar don't count.

categories.title: Abilities That Leap, Dash or Blink
categories.description: Their abilities move them across the board with a leap, jump, dash or blink.

categories.title: Abilities That Cut Armor or Magic Resist
categories.description: Their abilities lower enemy Armor or Magic Resist.

categories.title: Abilities That Replace Their Attacks
categories.description: Their abilities swap some of their basic attacks for something else.

categories.title: Abilities That Mention Burn
categories.description: Their ability text applies Burn or gets stronger against Burning enemies.

categories.title: Line Shots That Weaken per Enemy Hit
categories.description: Their abilities fire through a line of enemies and lose damage for each enemy hit.
categories.abilityPattern: (for each enemy (it passes through|hit)|per enemy hit)

categories.title: Abilities That Create Extra Units
categories.description: Their abilities bring extra units onto the board.

categories.title: Rewards That Outlast Combat
categories.description: Their abilities earn something you keep after the fight: permanent stats, anvils, unit copies or loot.

notes.leblanc: May copy an ally on your board after player combat.
notes.teemo: Forages mushrooms for rerolls, XP and Tactician Health.
